(III)--a son of पूर्णभद्र, the यक्ष; he became a devotee of शिव and gave up the svadharma of the यक्षस्. Hence the angry father banished him. He perform- [page३-749+ २७] ed austerities so severely at Benares for thousands of years that he was covered over with mud and eaten by ants till he was reduced to bones. शिव came to the spot with पार्वती and made him Dhanada, the गनेश्वर and क्षेत्रपाल; he was also made Annada. Two गणस् Udbhrama and Sambhrama were given for his service. Then शिव and पार्वती disappeared. M. १८०. 5-9, ८२. ९९; वा. ६९. १२.

--son of त्रिशन्कु and सत्यरता. Concern- ing him there was a battle between वसिष्ठ and विश्वामित्र in the disguise of birds for many years. Issueless, and advised by नारद, he prayed to वरुण for a son, promising to offer him in sacrifice to the deity. The son was Rohita. वरुण reminded him often about the promised sacrifice, and the king evaded saying that he was not yet fit for it. Knowing this Rohita left for forests and the king had a disease maho- dara: when the boy returned to relieve his father, Indra pre- vented him from going home. Six years passed and Rohita purchased सुनश्शेप, the second son of Ajiganta and returned home. हरिश्चन्द्र proceeded to offer सुनश्शेप in sacrifice and was relieved of his disease. सुनश्शेप was sold as a sacrificial animal to
